title: Strict quotient pullback towers and their Roos complex models
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a morphism $f:X\to Y$ on small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with completed integral coefficients and their positive finite quotients [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use the actual finite derived-reduction tower on flat-term K-flat complexes [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower] [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Use the strict pullback tower functor [def-a1-integral-finite-pullback-tower], which sends an input complex to the tower of restrictions of its finite pullbacks, with the actual quotient-linear transition maps defined by the scalar-unit generators. For any strict tower $C$ of complexes in an abelian category with countable products, define its adjacent step at $n$ to be $C(n+1)\to C(n)$ along the opposite successor arrow, and its Roos complex to be $\operatorname{Cone}(1-s)\text{ shifted by }-1$ with termwise products and the recorded shifted-cone differential [def-weil-derived-limit]. Define the pullback complex functor as that strict pullback tower followed by this Roos functor. No quasi-isomorphism invariance or descent assertion is part of this definition.
